title: Here’s Why You Shouldn’t Lock Your Naked Girlfriend Outside Your Apartment
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On April 1st, 2024. Officers were called to an apartment complex regarding a domestic violence issue & reports of a naked woman being locked outside her apartment. When officers tried knocking on the callers door, they refused to answer the door, after multiple attempts of knocking, a man opened the door and immediately got angry at police. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
